title: God’s Way Brings Rest
verse: Joshua conquered the whole land, just as the Lord had promised Moses, and he assigned Israel their tribal portions. Then the land was free of war.
observation: Over the past several chapters, the people have done great things and sometimes strange things. Let’s be honest, marching around a city for 7 days is strange. However, if God tells us to, He brings peace and rest with His commands. Trust Him and move forward.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always working for our good, even if that “good” is not what we had in mind.
